product_promise: TeacherOS remembers each class, turns evidence into the next best teaching action, and produces classroom-ready English materials in minutes—under teacher control.

north_star.definition: Distinct class loops completed in a seven-day reporting window after an accepted follow-up is attached to the next lesson for the same class.

privacy_classes.operational: Service health or configuration data with no teacher or classroom identifier.
privacy_classes.pseudonymous_product: Internal random IDs and action metadata; no names, handles, prompt text, generated content, student work, or free text.
privacy_classes.sensitive_aggregate: Counts or derived labels computed from classroom evidence; never raw evidence and accessible only to authorized product analysis.
privacy_classes.billing_restricted: Payment/subscription metadata; no card or bank credentials and restricted to billing operations.

analytics_rules.timestamp_standard: Server-generated UTC ISO-8601 at successful durable commit unless the event explicitly says otherwise.
analytics_rules.identity: Use internal user_id, class_id, loop_id, and resource_id only. Never send Telegram user IDs to analytics.
analytics_rules.retention: Raw product events: 13 months; aggregated cohorts: 25 months; deletion requests remove or irreversibly anonymize user-linked raw events within 30 days.
analytics_rules.late_or_duplicate_policy: Event UUIDs are idempotent. Use occurred_at for funnels and received_at for operations; accept events up to 72 hours late.

events.name: class_created
events.definition: A teacher-owned class profile is durably created with the minimum required fields.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC at class transaction commit

events.name: class_resource_generated
events.definition: A classroom-ready resource for a class is durably saved after a successful generation.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC after resource and usage records commit

events.name: lesson_marked_taught
events.definition: The teacher confirms that the planned lesson was taught; repeated taps do not create another event.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC at taught-status commit; taught_on is a separate teacher-selected date

events.name: outcome_saved
events.definition: The 30-second structured outcome is durably saved for a taught lesson.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC at outcome transaction commit

events.name: evidence_approved
events.definition: The teacher explicitly approves the structured extraction from uploaded or entered evidence; upload alone does not count.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC at approval commit

events.name: followup_accepted
events.definition: The teacher accepts a proposed next teaching action, with or without an explicit teacher edit.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC at accepted-action commit

events.name: loop_completed
events.definition: Emitted once when an accepted follow-up is attached to the next lesson for the same class and loop.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC at atomic loop-completion commit

events.name: teacher_control_used
events.definition: A teacher edits, rejects, retries, or deletes an AI-derived object through a supported control.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC after the requested control succeeds

events.name: time_saved_verified
events.definition: A teacher confirms a bounded time-saved estimate after comparing TeacherOS with their remembered manual workflow; estimates above 120 minutes require review and are excluded by default.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC at response commit

events.name: paywall_viewed
events.definition: A teacher is shown an upgrade screen because of a quota or gated capability.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC when the paywall message is successfully sent

events.name: subscription_activated
events.definition: A non-sandbox paid entitlement becomes active after idempotent payment verification.
events.timestamp: occurred_at: server UTC at subscription activation commit

navigation.back_rule: Every state has a visible callback-driven Back, Cancel, Done, or Main menu route. Slash commands are optional accelerators only.
navigation.stale_rule: Unknown, expired, unauthorized, or revision-mismatched callbacks answer the query and replace the keyboard with REC01 recovery actions.
navigation.security_rule: Payloads are locators, never authority. Resolve ownership and current revision server-side before every read or mutation.
navigation.idempotency_rule: Mutating actions use a server-side idempotency key derived from user, object, revision, and action.

feature_flags.rollout: owner -> internal cohort -> pilot allowlist -> percentage
feature_flags.rollback: Disable flag; preserve existing class rows read-only.

feature_flags.rollout: pilot allowlist after class CRUD checks
feature_flags.rollback: Disable class entry point; legacy generators remain available.
Disable capture; retain saved outcomes for export/deletion.

feature_flags.rollout: owner with synthetic data -> consented pilot
feature_flags.rollback: Stop uploads and processing; retain only according to consent/retention state.
Hide proposals; never auto-apply an unapproved diagnosis.
Stop emitting new events without blocking the product loop.
Fail open for already-created pilot classes; never delete data on downgrade.

entitlements.baseline_preserved: Current production behavior remains 10 successful generations/day on Free and unlimited generations on Pro/Premium; Premium may use a configured priority model.
rules: Do not enforce proposed class limits until willingness-to-pay evidence and billing tests approve class_entitlements_v1.
Downgrade never deletes classes, resources, outcomes, or evidence; excess classes become read-only and remain exportable/deletable.
A quota is consumed only after the corresponding durable object is successfully created.
Sandbox subscriptions never count as paid conversion.

deletion.effect: Hard-delete owned resource and derived exports; keep an anonymized deletion audit event.
deletion.recovery: No content recovery after confirmation; Cancel returns to detail.

deletion.effect: Delete blob, OCR text, thumbnails, and processing cache; keep approved aggregate only if separately disclosed and teacher chooses it.
Delete summary and invalidate dependent unapproved diagnoses/follow-ups.
deletion.recovery: Existing accepted teaching artifacts remain but lose evidence linkage.

deletion.confirmation: typed class label or two-step callback
deletion.effect: Cascade-delete class profile, loops, outcomes, evidence, diagnoses, follow-ups, and class-resource links; independently saved resource copies require explicit choice.
deletion.recovery: Seven-day soft-delete window for metadata only; raw evidence is purged immediately and cannot be restored.

deletion.effect: Revoke sessions/subscriptions, purge content and identifiers, and anonymize legally retained billing/audit records.
deletion.sla: access revoked immediately; completion within 30 days

deletion.effect: Remove or irreversibly anonymize user-linked raw events; aggregates no longer permit re-identification.

release_gates.criterion: Day 2 gate prints OPEN: at least five eligible interviews, 10-15 confirmed pilot recruits, repeated problems, and all product feature mappings witnessed or deferred.
At least one eligible teacher, unaided, correctly explains Home and all eight loop stages from the wireflow and identifies how to go back, reject a diagnosis, and delete evidence.
release_gates.evidence: De-identified signed test record; target three sessions before implementation freeze.

release_gates.criterion: Every contracted screen exposes a non-command escape path; callback payloads stay at or under 64 bytes and stale/unauthorized actions recover safely.
release_gates.evidence: Day 3 contract validator plus later interaction tests.

release_gates.criterion: Every metric event has a definition, timestamp, owner, privacy class, idempotency behavior, and prohibited-content enforcement.
release_gates.evidence: Day 3 contract validator plus later schema tests.

release_gates.criterion: Evidence consent, teacher approval, deletion cascade, access control, retention jobs, and model evaluation pass with synthetic then consented data.
release_gates.evidence: Threat model, evaluation report, deletion integration tests.

release_gates.criterion: Pilot evidence improves at least one governing measure without breaching trust thresholds: activation, weekly completed loops, verified time saved, retention, or paid conversion.
release_gates.evidence: Pilot scorecard with denominators and confidence caveats.

release_gates.criterion: Each class-intelligence capability can be disabled independently without deleting teacher data or breaking legacy generation.
